questionText:

questionRef: 2022 HL Section B Q1(b) — Deferred sitting
questionText:
Selon la Section A, Q.1, Hadrien dormait en plein air la plupart du temps pendant sa traversée de la France. Un jour, vous et quelques ami(e)s avez décidé de faire du camping à la campagne. Mais, malheureusement, vous avez rencontré des problèmes ! Racontez ce qui s’est passé. (Votre récit peut être réel ou imaginaire.)
(90 mots environ)

questionRef: 2022 HL Section B Q3 — Deferred sitting
questionText:
Your parents wish to organise a house exchange with a family in France for a month. Write an e‐mail in French to the family and include the following details: 
• Give a brief description of the accommodation you require 
• Tell them some details about your area 
• Describe some activities that could interest tourists in Ireland 
• Say you will travel to France by boat and will bring a car 
• Say that your family likes cycling and ask if they have bicycles.
(about 75 words)
